Four runners allocated campaign registry ids in parallel off the same `main`; merge order was G15 -> G16 -> G19 -> G17 and the earliest claimant kept the number, so G17's whole block moved: CASE-0151..0161 -> CASE-0184..0194, above the highest id any branch held. THE ROWS WERE NOT DROPPED - every one of them exists in cases.json today under its new number, and CASE-0151 is CASE-0184. Declared here rather than left to block because a record written BEFORE the renumber cites the old number correctly: planning/features-to-triage/X7-campaign-artifacts-underreport.md names CASE-0151-0154 because that is what the ledger under-reported on 2026-08-21, and rewriting that sentence to the new ids would make the citation resolve while claiming the audit had read rows that did not exist under those names on the day it ran. The whole block of eleven is declared, not only the one id a gate happens to have flagged, because all eleven were retired by the same commit for the same reason and declaring one would record a narrower fact than the true one.

Retired 2026-09-03 by re-running planning/test-campaign/bin/win-cases-from-lane.py, and it is a row that had OUTLIVED ITS SUBJECT rather than one that was lost. The generator writes an `n/a:` placeholder for every Windows surface whose status is `manual` - a surface the lane cannot reach - and CASE-0338 was that placeholder for SURF-044, the Discover detail dialog, saying it was 'not reachable from the shell's navigation, so the destination sweep never opens it'. SURF-044 is `ready` in surfaces-windows.json today: DEF-075's fix made the dialog addressable, the lane opens it, and the measurement is CASE-0347 control:discover.detail, which passes with all eight of its controls addressable and named. The surface's status changed in a commit that did not re-run the generator, so the stale placeholder survived until the next run removed it. NOTHING IS LESS COVERED THAN IT WAS: an unreachable-surface placeholder was replaced by a passing measurement of the same surface. Declared here rather than restored because restoring it would put 'not reachable' back into the registry over a dialog the lane opens on every run, and because three reckoning ledgers (planning/reckoning/2026-09-02, .../2026-09-02T2200, .../2026-09-03) cite CASE-0338 correctly for the day they ran.
